rule_title: TTP T1207 - DCShadow: LSASS accessing SAM password-related attributes on domain controller
description: Detects Event 4661 where lsass.exe accesses SAM objects (SAM_DOMAIN, SAM_SERVER, SAM_ALIAS) with properties referencing password-related schema GUIDs like {c7407360-20bf-11d0-a768-00aa006e0529} (password property set) and {bf9679a4/a5/a6} (individual password attributes).
